verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical, and both share the same main flaw. The 'Shop Flavours' CTA is jammed right after the subtitle with almost no gap, so it reads as an add-on to that line instead of a separate action. The legal line is also tiny and the pills sit loosely below. In B the logo and headline are pushed lower, which crowds the subtitle, pills and legal line together at the bottom and leaves dead space at the top. A spaces the content more evenly from top to bottom, so it has a slight edge.
